Storybook & fantasy · IDEA 02

Storybook Nook

CONCEPT ONLY · NO PRINT FILES

An open-book rain roof shelters a small reading-porch feeding drawer. Blank spine panels invite an original title, not a copied book cover.

This is an unbuilt design study. No CAD, STL, STEP, 3MF, print time, filament weight, price or physical test result is available. It is not ready to print, order or reserve.

Compare all four concepts

Shortlists stay in this browser. Nothing is submitted and no vote count is claimed.

How this could work

Design intent, not a claim that these mechanisms have been engineered or tested.

Different on purpose

A wall-mounted inverted-open-book pitched roof with one sheltered side porch; deliberately different from a turret or central silo.

Feeding system

A shallow daily-portion drawer, not a bulk hopper. The entire feeding surface should be reachable with a brush.

Refill & cleaning

Pull the drawer sideways while the backplate stays mounted. Add a positive stop that cannot be confused with its release.

Mounting approach

Proposed wall or post backplate. Substrate-specific screws or a suitable strap would be separate hardware.

Proposed print breakdown

Target: backplate/roof and one removable drawer. Overhangs and print orientation are not yet resolved.

Tests before this becomes a product

  1. Drawer retention under a visiting bird’s load
  2. Roof runoff outside the feed opening
  3. Brush access and seed removal from every corner

Before any download release: finish measured CAD, verify every connected solid and drain, arrange the real parts on plates, run a native slicer roundtrip, then perform fit, cleaning, seed-flow and load trials.

Why explore this direction?

Etsy Spring/Summer 2025 trend report (2025-04-10). Adjacent-market context, not proof of feeder demand.

Our theme-to-feeder interpretation is a hypothesis. A familiar aesthetic does not establish purchase intent, and the illustration is not a customer review or licensed collaboration.

Original geometry and naming should remain independent of protected characters, logos, book covers and recognizable franchise props.
